reader.notes: RemScaled computes a % b on scale-aligned Int128; C# % truncates toward zero, which is INTEGER-PART of the quotient, so the result equals the defining expression at the common scale. The value path consults no edition. Witness g85_f37_07 MATCHes at 85.
